description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.3

- Comprehensive Handle Restoration: Restores `@handles` back to original channel names across Comments, Shorts, Live Chat & Super Chats, Video Titles, Descriptions, and Video Subtitles.
- Smart Profile & Preview Card Exclusion: Intelligently preserves `@handles` on channel profile headers and preview bottom sheets to prevent duplicate name displays.
- High-Speed Stream Parsing & Dual-Layer Cache: Fast stream resolver (~0.5s) with zero API quota required, backed by in-memory LRU and persistent disk caches.
- Hierarchical Settings Controls: Integrated first-level Morphe preference screen with master switch cascading and multi-language support (zh-TW, zh-CN, en).
- Tested & Verified: Fully compatible with YouTube v21.30.216, Morphe Manager v2.5.0, and Morphe Patches v2.1.0+.
